2.text: Until you visit the graveyards.<sup foot_note="228280">1</sup>

footnotes.228280: - i.e., remain in them temporarily, meaning until the Day of Resurrection.

3.text: No! You are going to know.

4.text: Then, no! You are going to know.

5.text: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...<sup foot_note="228281">1</sup>

footnotes.228281: - The conclusion of this verse is estimated to be "...you would not have been distracted from preparing for the Hereafter."

6.text: You will surely see the Hellfire.

7.text: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.<sup foot_note="228282">1</sup>

8.text: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.<sup foot_note="228283">1</sup>

footnotes.228283: - i.e., the comforts of worldly life and whether you were grateful to Allāh for His blessings.
